description: Trial-and-error sequence mapping the valid humidity target range for ComfortableDehumidification (Dry) mode, each attempt otherwise identical to 19's payload (temperature=0.0, everything else carried over unchanged). Bundled into one file since each individual attempt is a single-field variation of the same request -- see const.py's DRY_MODE_HUMIDITY_RANGE for the resulting constant.

trials.note: Kevin's hypothesis: 50 is the lowest valid setting -- confirmed by this rejection.

trials.app_confirmed: not individually re-confirmed in-app, but same success pattern as 50/55

trials.note: First rejection above the confirmed-working values -- establishes the ceiling.
Tested first, before narrowing down -- Kevin's initial guess was 80% as the ceiling with 5% steps, which this trial sequence disproves.

notes: RESOLVED: valid humidity range for Dry mode is exactly {50, 55, 60} -- 3 discrete values, 5% steps, capped at 60%. NOT 80% or 100% as would be naively assumed from typical AC humidity-target conventions -- this unit's Dry mode genuinely only offers a narrow 50-60% band.

All rejections used the same generic E-21291-00007 code regardless of how far outside the valid range the value was (40 and 85 both equally rejected, no distinguishing 'out of range' signal) -- the only way to find the boundary was bisection via repeated live trials, there's no error message that states the valid range directly.
Final action: set humidity back to 55 (Kevin's last app-confirmed value) to leave the device in a known-good state, rather than leaving it on whatever the last (rejected) attempt implied.
